rows.item: Dupont jumper wires, female–female, 10 cm, a 40-wire strip
rows.notes: its channels to the neighbours' pins, a GND beside each group; one wire, its far end cut, soldered to the Pico 2's BOOTSEL pad (TP6) for the port's BOOT pin

rows.item: Dupont jumper wires, female–female, 20 cm, a 40-wire strip (DATA ×4 RESET/BOOT headers → the boards' pins: 1 wire)
rows.notes: the usual rainbow; GND black, RESET brown, BOOT green.  The DATA ×4's 1 × 3 headers and the boards' pin headers are soldered by hand, pins up

rows.item: USB PD charger, 100 W (20 V × 5 A), single port (e.g. Anker Nano 100 W, A2679)
rows.notes: dedicated to the rack: a multi-port charger may withdraw its full offer when something else is plugged in.  Realistic load ≈ 35–40 W.  At 20 V a row is capped at ≈ 32 W (its eFuse's 1.6 A), and the hub budgets the rows against the contract: it sheds rows before the charger trips.  For racks full of hungry DUTs, a 140 W PD 3.1 EPR charger (28 V): no hardware change

rows.item: USB-C to USB-C cable, 5 A, e-marked (100 W or 240 W rated), 1–2 m
rows.notes: required for 100 W: above 3 A a charger only offers its full current through an e-marked 5 A cable (a 3 A one gives 60 W).  A cable shipped with the charger and rated 100 W or more is one; 240 W rated for the 140 W EPR option

rows.item: Arducam Mega 3MP SPI camera, M12 version (B0434), 33 × 33 mm
rows.notes: on arrival: its header's order (VCC GND SCK MISO MOSI CS) and its MISO high level when fed 5 V (≤ 3.6 V, or change R33 and fit R35 on the node)

rows.item: M12 lens, 1/4", ≈ 120° diagonal (the stock 90° is too narrow for a NUCLEO-144 / nRF DK)
Cable JST XH 2.54 6-pin → Dupont female, one 6-pin housing, 10–20 cm (the Mega → pod J2, VCC GND SCK MISO MOSI CS in order)
rows.notes: the Mega's own 6-pin cable does if it ends in Dupont sockets; J2's pins are named on the board, so the wires go on by name

rows.item: Pod hardware: 2 × PT 2.6×14 (the pod board, through the diffuser's posts), cable ties 2.5 × 100 (the lead: 1 at the tray's rear slot, 3 under the ceiling)
